reply.summary: Telarstu is a green-skinned imp who idolises a caped crusader and keeps inviting himself along on missions. His whim-powered magic can build almost anything, but it fails against steel.

feats.scene: Telarstu conjures a rampaging giant toy and flattens a row of market stalls.
Telarstu is swatted aside by a steel girder and shakes his head.

reply.summary: Tevalcil is a tiny, unpronounceably named fan from another dimension who stacks the odds against his hero to prove a point. He can transform a villain into a crowned tyrant with an army of henchmen.

feats.scene: Tevalcil crowns a calendar-obsessed thief and fills a plaza with his henchmen.
Tevalcil takes a boot to the back and is unharmed.

reply.summary: Rnotiu is a gun-toting enforcer in a dark costume who serves a conquering tyrant and a mirror-league of villains. When his master's suit tears open, his entire universe is erased.

feats.scene: Rnotiu empties a rifle clip into a barricade in a single burst.
Rnotiu is thrown across a corridor and rolls to his feet.

reply.summary: Amosanolu is an ancient deep-sea horror freed by a drilling rig, who later wears a stolen cowl. He can threaten to boil every ocean and forces a sea king to bend the knee.

feats.scene: Amosanolu threatens to heat the seas to a rolling boil unless an old ally is slain.
Amosanolu wades through a hail of squad fire without a mark.

reply.summary: Tiausall is a stray dog empowered by a dark patron to become a clawed, winged hunter and partner in a vigilante's crusade. His tail is cut off during an ambush by a thief.

feats.scene: Tiausall tears a door off its hinges and leaps through the gap.
Tiausall endures a heavy blade slash and keeps tracking his quarry.
Tiausall sprints across a rooftop after a fleeing killer.

reply.summary: Iumvatiu is a desert warrior trained in archery, riding, firearms and blade work, who watches a failed uprising against her queen. She weighs her loyalty and sides with the crown.

feats.scene: Iumvatiu looses an arrow through a wooden target at long range.
Iumvatiu takes a sword blow on her shield and stays upright.

reply.summary: Naneon is a bald chaos sorcerer who trained under a stage magician and then conquered his entire world. He commands hordes of demons, binds a fiery spirit to his own soul and rules every realm of magic.

feats.scene: Naneon unleashes a demonic horde that overruns an island fortress in a night.
Naneon walks unharmed through a spell backlash that levels a courtyard.

reply.summary: Nulen is a night-prowling crimefighter in an old port city who melts into shadow and becomes a flock of winged creatures at will. He fights with glowing sticks that double as chained clubs.

feats.scene: Nulen cracks a glowing rod across a thief's shoulder and sends him sprawling.
Nulen takes a hit from a pair of thieves and walks it off.

reply.summary: Erter is a tall guardian of a far-future prison world who rose after a massacre of guards and their families. He trains his body and mind for lifetimes of discipline and calls himself an ideal.

feats.scene: Erter disarms three rioters in a single sweeping movement.
Erter takes a prison-yard beating and keeps on his feet.

reply.summary: Ntoanime is a dissident bomber in a vast red empire, hardened by the loss of his parents. He wages a long campaign of terror against a godlike ruler, becoming a legend among the oppressed.

feats.scene: Ntoanime blows up a barracks depot with a stack of homemade charges.
Ntoanime tumbles through a window and outruns the patrol.

reply.summary: Setantal is a young vigilante in a neon future city, daughter of the previous cowled hero. She wears a gadget-packed suit and moves with acrobatic grace and trained fists.

feats.scene: Setantal vaults a rail and drives both boots into a gang enforcer.
Setantal absorbs a baton blow on her armoured shoulder.

reply.summary: Rnole is a small barnyard hero in a cape and mask who narrates his own deeds. Equipped with gloves and a boast of sharp claws, he goes out for snacks and ends up foiling a poisoning plot.

feats.scene: Rnole scrambles up a fence and swats a croaking schemer with a paw.
Rnole drops from a haystack and lands squarely on his feet.

reply.summary: Torri is a quiet, neatly dressed attendant who is secretly a master of the occult, able to read minds and cast a ghostly double of himself. He also flies planes and throws knives for an espionage ring.

feats.scene: Torri hurls a knife into a post across a crowded room.
Torri shakes off a jab in a back alley and responds in kind.

reply.summary: Irnia is a thinking, chatty rescue jet with a sleek sensor-eyed face who joins a squad of sentient vehicles. She trades speed and tactics for gadgetry and flies rescue sorties in the dark.

feats.scene: Irnia dives through a storm cloud and drops a tow cable onto a stranded bridge.
Irnia endures a crash landing in a field and powers back up.
Irnia breaks the sound barrier above a coastal city.

reply.summary: Stotelton is a lanky infantryman in a desert battle who hauls a wounded comrade across the sand. When a storm of bullets arrives, he accepts the risk and dies protecting his friend.

feats.scene: Stotelton hurls a grenade across a dune and silences a machine-gun nest.
Stotelton shields a wounded friend from a burst of fire at close range.

reply.summary: Anuvarve is a red-haired, immortal youth of a bright sky-realm who travels with a band of free spirits. His great strength and leaping power make him a tank among his companions.

feats.scene: Anuvarve punches a crag and sends a landslide down a valley.
Anuvarve stands his ground as a cliff face collapses on him.

reply.summary: Cortaiu is a green-skinned outlaw in a medieval farming realm with sharp canine teeth who shifts into any creature he has seen. He can become a dragon, flying and breathing flame.

feats.scene: Cortaiu rises as a dragon and torches a whole siege tower.
Cortaiu takes a catapult stone in dragon form and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Niunan is a shy, red-furred demon exiled from the underworld for having a kind heart, and is bound to a boy through a careless ritual. He is a gentle companion hiding from the world until an evil elder returns.

feats.scene: Niunan lifts a wrecked sedan over his head to free a trapped child.
Niunan weathers a thrown anvil without a flinch.

reply.summary: Osate is a living stereo built by two teenagers who fused a staff with a speaker, now a loyal pet and brawler. The little machine fights with rhythm and an enthusiasm for noise.

feats.scene: Osate blasts a bass pulse that knocks a stack of crates over.
Osate is knocked off a shelf and keeps the beat going.

reply.summary: Corti is a winged criminal who steals and defaces statues and carries a deadly secret about her origin. Born as an antibody against divine beings, she devours souls and fires blasts strong enough to pierce a demigod.

feats.scene: Corti projects a lance of raw energy that opens a hole in a titan's chest.
Corti takes a point-blank blast from a rival and drags herself to her feet.

reply.summary: Teser is a former model and secret operative who gains blazing powers in a plasma blast and joins an international team of heroes. She bends flame to her will and wears a famous green outfit.

feats.scene: Teser wraps an armoured truck in green flame and melts its frame.
Teser walks through a burning warehouse untouched.

reply.summary: Torllori is an executive who transforms through ancient magic into a flaming champion. Her emerald fire can heal small wounds, repair her clothes, fly her like a rocket and cast dazzling illusions.

feats.scene: Torllori sprays white-hot flame across a barricade and melts it into slag.
Torllori is thrown through a boardroom window and lands in a controlled flame-blast.

reply.summary: Orirnva is a green-haired psychic with burning mental force who flies in an aura of emerald fire shaped like a bird. She joins a team of mutant-like heroes and a rival circle of villains.

feats.scene: Orirnva hurls a bird of green flame that smashes through a steel bulkhead.
Orirnva endures a collapsing ship corridor in her flaming aura.

reply.summary: Austiirn is a flame-wielding villain from a far-future age who heats matter like a microwave oven and rides updrafts for flight. She is eventually frozen solid by a cunning foe who tunnels behind her.

feats.scene: Austiirn sweeps a stream of fire across a volcanic plain and wraps a rival in flame.
Austiirn burns off a hail of bullets before they reach her.

reply.summary: Natere is a crook who commands swarms of biting insects that infect people's minds while they sleep. He sends sleepwalking victims out on robberies and then vanishes into hiding.

feats.scene: Natere sends a swarm of insects to a sleeper and the victim cracks a safe.
Natere is knocked sprawling in a scuffle with two heroes and flees.

reply.summary: Orainu is a knight of an ancient fellowship whose spirit is bound inside a lance after a king's son betrays the order. With no body of his own, he waits for a new hand to wield him.

feats.scene: Orainu drives the lance through a stone shield in a single thrust.
Orainu endures centuries inside the lance, unbroken by the curse.

reply.summary: Valau is a purple-eyed soldier from a dark world who flies, reads thoughts and bends minds. He takes control of captives to open a portal strong enough to pull a planet toward his master's realm.

feats.scene: Valau seizes the minds of three captives and holds a portal open against a counterattack.
Valau takes a hydro-blast to the chest and stumbles away.

reply.summary: Oreorre is a being woven entirely of old evil magic, born in a relic of the deep. He grows and shrinks at will, whips up gales that wreck a headquarters and rewrites reality to suit himself.

feats.scene: Oreorre summons a gale that wrecks the wall of a hilltop base and scatters its defenders.
Oreorre shrugs off a team's combined attack and swells to fill the room.

reply.summary: Valca is a purple-skinned corps soldier wearing a ring of yellow fear-light that makes constructs, shields and flight. He helps a squad pin down a rival corps.

feats.scene: Valca fires a lance of yellow light and cracks a concrete pylon.
Valca holds up a shimmering shield against a rifle volley.

reply.summary: Loeonri is a scheming ruler of the underworld who possesses hosts, shifts shape, bends minds and teleports. He tricks a living visitor into abandoning a friend for a soul that did not wish to leave.

feats.scene: Loeonri tears open the floor of his throne room and swallows an entire legion.
Loeonri stands untouched in a rite meant to banish him.

reply.summary: Vinisa is a mechanic aboard a time-travelling ship who once wielded a wind relic as a vigilante in a bleak future. His timeline shifts and he becomes a member of a ragged crew of heroes.

feats.scene: Vinisa spins a cyclone from the relic and flings a patrol vehicle over a wall.
Vinisa is blasted through a hull plate and picks himself up.

reply.summary: Mitilte is an immortal ruler of a fiery realm, a goddess of love who can stir deep affection in others, though she falls for her target in return. She also senses the bonds of those around her.

feats.scene: Mitilte raises a hand and an entire army of soldiers lays down its weapons in tears.
Mitilte stands calmly in a rain of fire from her own pits.
